ranking.name: Cambria Hotel New Orleans Downtown Warehouse District

text.text_excerpt: I liked this hotel and it's in a perfect location that is close to the French Quarter and surrounded by lots of restaurants, coffee shops, bars, etc. but it also quiet for when you finally head to sleep. The vibe of the place is a little hipster-ish for me but I still really liked it. The rooms are clean and quiet and the beds and pillows are comfortable. The employees are really friendly and you get a free coaster if you become a Choice Hotels member. The housekeeping is a little weird since it seems like the only come for a limited window each morning so I had to request clean towels once day but it wasn't a big deal. I didn't have a car so I didn't deal with any of the parking issues o...

The hotel is in a great location just a short walk from the riverfront, bars, restaurants and about 15 minutes from the French Quarter. The staff are super friendly and the hotel is clean and very comfortable with some nice "local touches" like skulls on the chairs, local paintings etc. The rooms are very spacious and modern. The beds are super comfortable and the bathroom has a great non-slip rubber floor. The shower curtains have to be seen to be believed. The room has a fridge and coffee making amenities but, oddly, no drawer space, just a closet to hang clothes. The bar/restaurant has some great dishes and there are lots of other places nearby to eat and drink. My one disappointment w...

I was curious what it would be like to stay in the #1 rated hotel in NOLA on a recent business trip, and it certainly wasn't lacking. Staff that quickly got you checked in on arrival, who learned your name and remembered you (!), who greeted you every time you came back and asked if you needed anything. The one time I had a key card issue, they had someone at my door within a minute, didn't even have me go downstairs to get a new card. They came to me. Shower was really nice, though got SO hot that you could note the change in water pressure. Not a negative, just interesting.
